The '''Kor Nijiladii system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and was part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] section of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was connected by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Kor Hestilic system/Legends|Kor Hestilic system]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Kor Nijiladii system contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Kor Nijiladii]], the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Nijiladii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].<ref name="TEA Kor Nijiladii" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kor Nijiladii system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square S-10.<ref name="TEA" />
